description: Find campaigns, ad squads or ads by (part of) their name and get their ids (read-only). Every word you type must appear in the name, in any order; accents and Arabic letter variants are ignored. Shows the parent campaign (and ad squad) and the daily budget of ad squads. Use this first when you only know a name, then use the id with the other tools. Pass types to include ads; a full id also works.

ad_account_id.description: Ad account id. Optional: defaults to SNAP_AD_ACCOUNT_ID (set by setup). snap_ping shows the current one.

query.description: Words to look for in the names, for example: Ramadan KSA

types.description: What to search. Ads are slower to search because an account can have thousands.

name: snap_find
